[Highlight start] **There is no direct interaction between Tamiflu (oseltamivir) and alcohol** [Highlight end] , so alcohol will not stop Tamiflu from working. However, it is generally best to avoid alcohol while taking it because drinking can worsen side effects, slow your recovery, and interact with other flu remedies.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF18fW_JJ7eMGYvjA4JnGeLUglvPMuOIAtIZt8gHRToy0uiqJDOXgZS0DPSrB72v5P6sfPbHoUivV_fRWRWF8QCxfaS8or7OY52jDparv3NFd2n05jRyN8uc2FSebFerCXFrYfjVwpD-qbFmJdMY6gR9qkWOr9gEUc8vYOACw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXWLaDsLOqbL5BOOtOwob8FjZV3uJEjwuTAFDYT4aCjPMNnkbfnezRnct68JhdaKGNl7uL6tYgfGS7JpttJ5Kj0rQu0guWHaCPxAwJNHn0CH_ZvFh3hACJvX_ihLpKZ25pzg)

### Why Doctors Often Recommend Avoiding Alcohol

- **Worsened side effects:** Alcohol and Tamiflu can share or amplify effects like nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dizziness, and headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1zfrA6SI-bYfH9NVhSN1XpsGCkkEA0sifkoDK_1aotgOoP8XA3V83e-PLlIi4LzRMj0ZM4lg_9ktPMI1pmuRQBT37BB0SdynDtPRHbyW7BfKjOgpVKpsFVTB7UJrWNhW3LrtgX35I-arybS3BIlxSW7nqsOJb2Czt2SI7erH8w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF18fW_JJ7eMGYvjA4JnGeLUglvPMuOIAtIZt8gHRToy0uiqJDOXgZS0DPSrB72v5P6sfPbHoUivV_fRWRWF8QCxfaS8or7OY52jDparv3NFd2n05jRyN8uc2FSebFerCXFrYfjVwpD-qbFmJdMY6gR9qkWOr9gEUc8vYOACw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESogEBxCJF1z0zX62oJReE26hl_lCyfo7mrb3HDTOz4-XclutKWfzvMM4cTVU_isbtQLmeHj_CJd5eMNwDRigCO5KpbDNsflOLOLHz8AQgA5hmC6KDWixScU3LqLXOhehVSI-SHPdVnevS4mASpdfhQ5Piv93GkmvK-cgfUQyNYxhrIzG0YDJN3Af2TSGutx32FkXw8t4u2u7hmqUrlbKQz6N-enI)
- **Dehydration and poor sleep:** Alcohol dehydrates your body and disrupts restful sleep, which can make flu symptoms feel harsher.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF142H8gustsqY-gDZfxalRLY32pBoXhWPSVlgwaMU4z4tT39GJPA01U9yRtXuweUN562LK2NmIHgWAY5RuAOTP6Omh2BQeE8eCjRwG68l_yAy2jc4hODGdb8SnBGbqKVs5CAxeYSCbN7oN9ckgup0AKaoZNvr8194LgRUWceneUjYCJX3tl5f0y6Hx_wj)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF18fW_JJ7eMGYvjA4JnGeLUglvPMuOIAtIZt8gHRToy0uiqJDOXgZS0DPSrB72v5P6sfPbHoUivV_fRWRWF8QCxfaS8or7OY52jDparv3NFd2n05jRyN8uc2FSebFerCXFrYfjVwpD-qbFmJdMY6gR9qkWOr9gEUc8vYOACw)
- **Immune and recovery impact:** Heavy drinking can weaken your immune response and prolong recovery while you fight off an infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXMFV5HV3Z9XFurD_cH6hIO5Ctm11lDOxpSl2g-lF9cX2AHIWPs9yPmSzoyisaIqMryJQmPDOwzJHG3LwpKb00epVa-QxBH8-_ca47tRu9H8ksAOsfmb-sQ72MtecPY9NeBf7zyrLuF80t3WQBY-aMNxaZ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF18fW_JJ7eMGYvjA4JnGeLUglvPMuOIAtIZt8gHRToy0uiqJDOXgZS0DPSrB72v5P6sfPbHoUivV_fRWRWF8QCxfaS8or7OY52jDparv3NFd2n05jRyN8uc2FSebFerCXFrYfjVwpD-qbFmJdMY6gR9qkWOr9gEUc8vYOACw)
